HYPNOSISCREATOR-FEEDBACK.description: Send feedback or bug reports about the Hypno Creator mod. Only your message, the mod version, and your display language are sent; screenshots and logs are not attached.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FEEDBACK.placeholder:
Please describe your suggestions for improvements or any bugs you encountered.
If you have steps to reproduce the issue, including them would be helpful.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FEEDBACK.busy: Feedback is already being sent. Please wait.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FEEDBACK.rate_limited: Too many messages were sent in a short time. Your message has been kept; please try again later.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FEEDBACK.invalid: This message could not be sent. Check its length and contents.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FEEDBACK.failed: Could not send feedback. Your message has been kept; please try again later.

HYPNOSISCREATOR-DATA_UPLOAD.label: Send gameplay data
HYPNOSISCREATOR-DATA_UPLOAD.description:
When a run with Hypno Creator ends, gameplay data is sent anonymously.
It is used for card balance adjustments and bug fixes. No personally identifying data (such as Steam IDs or names) is sent. This switch is linked to the game's own data-upload setting.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-DATA_UPLOAD.unavailable: The game's data-upload setting is not available.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-DATA_UPLOAD.failed: Could not save the data-upload setting. It was not changed.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FULL_UNLOCK.description: For players whose unlocks were reset because modded play uses a separate save. Unlocks every card, relic, potion, and more.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FULL_UNLOCK.button: Unlock all Slay the Spire 2 content
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FULL_UNLOCK.confirmation:
Unlock all content in Slay the Spire 2 (cards, relics, potions, events, and more) and Ascension through A10 for every character.
Changes are saved automatically and cannot be undone.
Proceed?
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FULL_UNLOCK.unlocked: All content and Ascension through A10 have been unlocked.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FULL_UNLOCK.already_unlo: All applicable content and Ascension levels are already unlocked.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FULL_UNLOCK.run_in_progr: Cannot unlock content during a run. Return to the main menu first.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FULL_UNLOCK.profile_chan: The profile changed during confirmation, so the action was cancelled. Press the button again.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-FULL_UNLOCK.failed: Could not unlock all content. Return to the main menu and try again.
